text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool dc-eu-3 experiencing p99 latency > 6s for the last 5m. Queue depth spike observed: 1.2k -> 4.3k. Autoscaler lag ~90s on recent burst. Paging oncall now.

emma (oncall): on it — grabbing logs and metrics, paging SRE. anyone already looking at customer tickets?

raj (sre): I’m pulling pool-level metrics. Can someone confirm model and whether there was any recent deploy to this pool?

lina (runtime): Model is rw-13b-q4f. No recent prod deploys to this pool in the last 24h. We saw a quantization config tweak in staging yesterday only. Attaching quick metrics summary: p95 from ~1.2s -> 2.8s, p99 from ~4.5s -> 7.1s, streaming stall count jumped x6.

jack (eng): Observing heavy KV cache miss rate on replicas created during the burst. New replicas show ~500ms cold-start for prefix cache fill per active shard. That explains tail stalls.

maria (support): Two enterprise tenants have reported timeouts and elevated error rates — tickets #7882 and #7883. They’re blocking on low latency for real-time inference.

emma (oncall): Can we scale pool manually while we investigate autoscaler behavior? Raj, can you try manual scale + ensure warmup prefetch on new nodes?

raj (sre): Executing manual scale now. Command:

```
# scale pool dc-eu-3 by adding 8 nodes and enable prefetch
cloudctl dedicated scale --pool dc-eu-3 --add 8 --warmup-mode prefetch
```

raj (sre): Running. ETA for new replicas to enter ready state ~60-90s.

incident-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-warmup — follow "prefetch KV cache" section.

lina (runtime): Important: please enable prefix prefetch seeding or new replicas will hit massive KV churn and stall. I’ll push a runtime config toggle to opt-in for prefetch on scaleup.

jack (eng): Also deploying a temporary gateway rule to reduce per-session streaming concurrency on dc-eu-3 to limit tail amplification. Patch: set `max_concurrent_streams=8` for that pool.

```
# temp routing change
routesctl update dc-eu-3 --set max_concurrent_streams=8 --reason "mitigate tail latency during warmup"
```

raj (sre): Scale command completed; 8 nodes added. Warmup logs show average prefix prefetch time ~70s due to KV throughput. Queue depth dropped 4.3k -> 600 after warmup finished. p99 back down to ~2.1s but we still see intermittent streaming stalls (~0.5% of requests).

emma (oncall): Good. Maria, can you send a quick customer update with mitigation steps and ETA? Tell them we scaled and enabled cache prefetch; we’re doing RCA.

maria (support): Drafting now: "We’ve mitigated elevated latency by adding capacity and enabling cache prefetch; you may see transient delays as replicas finish warmup. We’re investigating root cause and will follow up within 4 hours." Will post once approved.

lina (runtime): Preliminary root cause: autoscaler policy was too conservative for the observed sudden burst profile (fast spike in incoming QPS). Warmup prefetch was disabled by default for scaleups to save network IO, which made new replicas start with cold KV caches and amplified tail latency. Also noticed slow disk I/O on a subset of newly attached nodes causing slower prefetch throughput.

jack (eng): Action items I recommend: 1) make prefetch-on-scaleup the default for dedicated pools with streaming workloads; 2) add a burst-policy to autoscaler to treat spikes >X RPS as fast-path (scale faster), 3) add gateway backpressure when queue >1000 to prevent overwhelming autoscaler.

raj (sre): Created follow-up incident ticket INF-1129 for autoscaler tuning + disk perf followup. Assigning to eng/runtime and infra.

emma (oncall): Handing off to daytime oncall for RCA and post-incident followup: @sasha you’re up for timeline & root cause writeup. I’ll mark pager cleared.

sasha (oncall): Ack — I’ll own the RCA doc and coordinate with infra to audit disk perf on new node images, and with runtime to change default prefetch behavior.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT MITIGATED — p99 reduced and queue drained. Customers notified. Post-incident RCA and timeline to follow in INF-1129.

emma (oncall): Great job team. We’ll reconvene after the RCA draft. :thumbsup:
